text:
Sam Chen: Quick sync — prepping cloud partner enablement bundle: reference archs, Terraform modules, SI checklist, and marketplace packaging for AWS/GCP. Also need HW-validated AMI naming. Who's on this?
Leah Ortiz: I'm on. I sketched a repo layout + TF module versioning policy. Pushed initial README to https://github.com/redwood-partners/cloud-templates (draft).
Arjun Patel: FYI AWS Marketplace requires Private Offer + CloudFormation/stack examples for listing. Recommend we ship both CloudFormation and Terraform usage docs. Also our HW partner (CoreCompute) will provide AMIs but they want a strict naming convention and signing metadata.
Maria Gomez: Minimal Terraform example we can include in examples/ — something like:
```
module "redwood_dedicated" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/terraform-modules/aws/dedicated"
  version = "v0.1.0"
  instance_type = "p4d.24xlarge"
  ami = "corecompute-redwood-ami-2026-02-15"
}
```
Leah Ortiz: Also add a "private_deploy" template that provisions VPC endpoints, KMS keys (customer-managed), and SSM parameter store for config. Keep variables minimal for quickstart.
Arjun Patel: For SI integrations we should include: onboarding checklist (SAML certs, network CIDR, firewall rules), contact matrix (SE, infra, legal), runbook for cutover, and a template SOW. Keep a small sample playbook for MSSP handover.
Sam Chen: Timeline check: need ext-ready artifacts by Fri EOD so Marketplace/legal can start the listing review. Marketplace packaging is the blocker. @marketplace-bot can you confirm listing constraints and required artifacts?
marketplace-bot: Checklist for AWS/GCP marketplace listing: legal review signoff, manifest.yaml, signed AMIs/images, support plan doc, pricing matrix, sample CloudFormation and Terraform examples. Created provisional listing ID: https://marketplace.example/listing/12345.
Maria Gomez: Also add a "publish module" doc for Terraform Registry: steps = tag release, run terraform-docs to generate README, push release, trigger registry publish pipeline. Add CI job to validate examples with a small smoke deploy (t. plan & apply against sandbox).
Leah Ortiz: We'll add automated tests: terratest for modules + a smoke pipeline that runs on PRs. Add a gating job that verifies AMI exists in target region.
Arjun Patel: Hardware partner requested performance numbers to include in the reference arch: 99th pct latency at target QPS, token/sec throughput for sample model (e.g., 7B, 70B), and cost per 1M tokens estimate with our suggested batch configs. I'll draft a small perf doc and load test harness.
Sam Chen: I'll sync with comms on joint announcement timeline — propose joint announcement 2 weeks after listing goes live. Who owns the template PRs?
Leah Ortiz: I'll own infra templates & AWS/GCP packaging PRs.
Maria Gomez: I'll open the module PRs and examples later today and tag @Leah for review. Will add example outputs and minimal smoke test. :thumbsup:
marketplace-bot: Reminder: weekly partner sync Tue 11:00am. Added checklist tasks to PR #42 and created ticket PARTNER-89 for AMI signing metadata.
